prompt: Mailvora's GA4 export sits in BigQuery as one table per day, named events_YYYYMMDD, in the dataset mailvora-web.analytics_254316. Which BigQuery query adds up the value parameter of October 2025's purchases, from whichever number slot holds it, and reads only October's daily tables?

options.text: A cross join to the unnested list that adds up the double_value slot alone

code.sql:
SELECT SUM(p.value.double_value) AS purchase_value
FROM `mailvora-web.analytics_254316.events_*`
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(event_params) AS p
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20251001' AND '20251031'
  AND event_name = 'purchase'
  AND p.key = 'value'

options.text: A cross join to the unnested list, every number slot, a _TABLE_SUFFIX range

code.sql:
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(p.value.int_value, p.value.float_value, p.value.double_value)) AS purchase_value
FROM `mailvora-web.analytics_254316.events_*`
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(event_params) AS p
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20251001' AND '20251031'
  AND event_name = 'purchase'
  AND p.key = 'value'

options.text: A cross join to the unnested list, every number slot, a range on the event_date column

code.sql:
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(p.value.int_value, p.value.float_value, p.value.double_value)) AS purchase_value
FROM `mailvora-web.analytics_254316.events_*`
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(event_params) AS p
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '20251001' AND '20251031'
  AND event_name = 'purchase'
  AND p.key = 'value'

options.text: An unnest that names each element with a column alias, every number slot, a _TABLE_SUFFIX range

code.sql:
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(p.value.int_value, p.value.float_value, p.value.double_value)) AS purchase_value
FROM `mailvora-web.analytics_254316.events_*`, unnest(event_params) AS t(p)
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20251001' AND '20251031'
  AND event_name = 'purchase'
  AND p.key = 'value'
